Policies and Initiatives.title: Govt signs MoU with ARF for AI-driven urban governance
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Odisha's housing department has partnered with IIT Kanpur's AIRAWAT Research Foundation to enhance urban governance through artificial intelligence. The collaboration aims to leverage AI for better urban planning and service delivery, and an AI Project Management Unit will be established. This initiative will create a multi-year AI roadmap for Odisha's urban development goals.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 1,700 delegates from 24 countries to attend AI, fintech meet: Govt
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Odisha is set to host a major AI and fintech summit, bringing together 1,700 delegates from 24 countries to discuss digital finance and AI integration. The state aims to cultivate a skilled workforce and establish Bhubaneswar as a global hub, with goals including job creation and enhanced global competitiveness. The summit will focus on actionable strategies for achieving measurable economic outcomes.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Rare earths found in state can power India’s dreams: Singhdeo
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Odisha's coastal region is rich in rare earth minerals, essential for India's semiconductor industry, with deposits found to be shallow and commercially viable for extraction. Deputy Chief Minister KV Singhdeo has highlighted the area's potential, citing its importance for India's ambitions. A Singaporean firm is already involved, indicating global interest in Odisha's critical mineral resources.

Major AI Developments.title: Odisha Plus II exams begin smoothly: No malpractice reported, AI cameras monitor
Major AI Developments.summary: Odisha's higher secondary examinations began smoothly with over 96,000 science students taking the first paper under tight security, including AI-powered CCTV surveillance. No malpractice was reported, although a minor question paper discrepancy was addressed. The exams were conducted statewide with the Chief Minister encouraging students to approach the exams with calmness and confidence.

Major AI Developments.title: Jumbo deaths averted with installation of AI towers
Major AI Developments.summary: Rourkela forest division has successfully prevented train-elephant collisions for a year using AI-enabled protection towers, the first in Odisha. The system issued 880 alerts, preventing 46 incidents and saving approximately 270 elephants. This technology has marked a significant step towards wildlife conservation and coexistence.

Major AI Developments.title: Proposed AI hub in state to shift economic trajectory, says official at AI summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Odisha is set to become India's next AI hub with a proposed Rs 20,000 crore sovereign AI hub, creating 5,000 high-skilled jobs. The state aims to integrate AI across various sectors, including healthcare, education, and governance, to drive technology-led growth. This initiative seeks to provide inclusive digital services to all citizens, particularly in rural areas.

Major AI Developments.title: Six East Coast Railway trains part of railways’ onboard services reform
Major AI Developments.summary: East Coast Railway has selected six long-distance trains for Indian Railways' 'Better Onboard Services' reform, aiming to enhance cleanliness and passenger amenities. The initiative will introduce continuous cleaning models, technology-enabled teams, and multi-tasking teams for minor repairs. AI-powered monitoring will also be used to ensure compliance with the new onboard services standards.

Major AI Developments.title: Odisha readies for smooth conduct of HS exams
Major AI Developments.summary: Odisha's state government has finalized measures for the Annual Higher Secondary Examination, which will involve over 4 lakh students across 1,357 centers. The exams, taking place from February 18 to March 28, will feature strict protocols, including AI-enabled surveillance and a ban on electronic devices. These measures aim to ensure a transparent and malpractice-free examination period.
